title: Infographics / Technical diagrams — Design

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; visible default tab states

slide_intent: Make structural relationships legible through consistent nodes and connectors so viewers can distinguish hierarchy, sequence and meaning in complex systems.
strategic_value: A common diagram vocabulary can make IBM technical communication recognizable while reducing the effort needed to decode each new diagram.
demonstration: The webpage progresses from complete diagrams to bullet, small and large nodes, connectors, icon and type rules, measured grid construction, color tables and additional indicators.
practical_value: Select a node type for the amount of information, then construct and label connections on the shared grid without relying on color alone.

content_islands.name: Resources and examples
content_islands.spec: Place starter-kit and library cards above a group of complete technical diagrams illustrating different densities and structures.

content_islands.name: Node family
content_islands.spec: Compare bullet, small and large nodes, then show text behavior and nesting with the visible default tab.

content_islands.name: Connections
content_islands.spec: Arrange line styles and endings above four routing examples: square elbow, rounded elbow, straight and curved.

content_islands.name: Icons and type
content_islands.spec: Follow with icon/logo examples, type specifications, alignment diagrams and red-marked prohibited text treatments.

content_islands.name: Grid and spacing
content_islands.spec: Place dimensioned node drawings before the gridded full-diagram example and artboard guidance.

content_islands.name: Color
content_islands.spec: Keep the light/dark specification table with example nodes and rejected low-contrast or mixed-color treatments.

content_islands.name: Additional elements
content_islands.spec: Finish with line styles, indicator badges and offset repeated-instance examples, keeping their legend and counting instructions attached.

reference_purposes.Intent: The introduction states that diagrams make relationships, hierarchy and sequence clear; color guidance explains redundant encoding for accessibility.
reference_purposes.Expression: The diagrams combine IBM Plex, UI icons, restrained color and regular node geometry.
reference_purposes.Application: The page specifies 8px construction, node formats, 24px node icons, 16px badge icons, label hierarchy and routing alternatives.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Never rely on color alone. A legend is always required, nodes remain monochromatic, and repeated instances use two offset lines regardless of the actual count.

ingredient.name: Technical-diagram nodes and connectors
ingredient.application: Choose bullet, small or large nodes for the content; snap nodes and connectors to an 8px grid and explain color and line meanings in a legend.
ingredient.scope: IBM technical documentation diagrams. Small nodes require icons; large nodes can omit them. The 8px construction and legend requirement are specific to this guidance.
